title: fix(i18n): title the AI drawer with the top-bar button's name in every locale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNgJrQDxaUNx2so1ektgf6A)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfrh8TiPJf1i2kMSoa

Fixes #34827

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AI 助手抽屉的标题(侧边抽屉、铺满后、手机底部面板三处)现在和顶栏按钮同名,zh-Hans/zh-Hant 是「AI 助手」,en 是 "AI Assistant",其余 8 种语言也都用各自顶栏按钮那个词。
- 为什么改:验收时看到顶栏按钮叫「AI 助手」,点开后抽屉标题只写「助手」,同一个东西两个名字。
- 风险与回滚:只改了 11 个语言包里 `console.ai.dock.title` 的值,外加抽屉组件里同一个键的英文兜底文字;不动布局和行为。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts` 与 `en.ts` 的 `dock.title` 一行;`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ChatDock.tsx` 两处 `defaultValue`;新测试 `ChatDock.titleMatchesTopBar-34827.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ChatDock.titleMatchesTopBar-34827.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全过;或在中文界面点顶栏机器人,抽屉标题与按钮提示同为「AI 助手」。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `console.ai.dock.title` now carries the same value as `topbar.aiAssistant` (the key the top-bar robot reads for its `aria-label` and `title`) in all eleven built-in packs:

  | pack | before | after |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | en | Assistant | AI Assistant |
  | zh-Hans / zh-Hant | 助手 | AI 助手 |
  | ja | アシスタント | AI アシスタント |
  | ko | 어시스턴트 | AI 어시스턴트 |
  | de | Assistent | KI-Assistent |
  | fr | Assistant | Assistant IA |
  | es / pt-BR | Asistente / Assistente | Asistente de IA / Assistente de IA |
  | ru | Ассистент | ИИ-ассистент |
  | ar | المساعد | مساعد الذكاء الاصطناعي |

- That one key is the title of all three drawer forms: the side rail and the window-filling form (`ChatDockPanel`, the same header in both) and the phone sheet (`ChatDockMobileSheet`). Nothing passes a `title` prop to either in the Console (`useConsoleChatDock` mounts both without one), and the Studio panel no longer mounts `ChatDockPanel`, so the value change reaches exactly the drawer.
- `ChatDock.tsx`: the two inline `defaultValue`s for that key change from `'Assistant'` to `'AI Assistant'`. This is not optional: `check-i18n-call-site-keys` requires every literal inline default to equal the en value, and its test (`scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts`, "main carries no drift") went red on the value change alone. No layout or behaviour change.
- The dispatch named the en button as `aiChat: 'AI assistant'`. That key is `console.shortcuts.groups.aiChat`, the keyboard-shortcuts dialog's group heading. The robot reads `topbar.aiAssistant` (`AssistantTopBarButton`), whose en value is `AI Assistant`, so that is the value matched.
- `console-namespace-3546.test.tsx` carried French `dock.title` = `Assistant` as its one permitted en-identical cognate; French now reads `Assistant IA`, so the exemption set is empty and the test now pins that the three French values containing the word differ from en. One comment in `marketplace-preview-namespace-3546.test.tsx` that counted that cognate is corrected.

### Item 2: other self-names in the same panel

Checked against the keys the drawer actually renders (`ChatDock.tsx`, `ChatDockConversation.tsx` and what it mounts: `ChatPane` from `AiChatPage.tsx`, `ConversationsSidebar.tsx`):

| key | zh-Hans / en | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `console.ai.dock.description` (phone sheet, screen-reader only) | AI 助手对话 / AI assistant chat | already uses the full name; unchanged |
| `ConversationsSidebar` (history list): `chats`, `noChatsYet`, `noChatsDescription`, `searchChats`, `newChat` | 对话 / Chats, … | no self-name; unchanged |
| `console.ai.empty.build.*`, `console.ai.empty.ask.*` (empty states) | 用 AI 搭建 / Build with AI, 向你的数据提问 / Ask your data | no self-name; unchanged |
| `console.ai.unavailableTitle` / `unavailableDescription` | AI 助手不可用 / AI assistant unavailable | already the full name; unchanged |
| `console.ai.switchAssistant`, `chooseAgent`, `loadingAgents`, `offlineDemoMode` | 切换助手, 选择助手…, … | 助手 here means an agent in the picker, not the panel's name; unchanged |
| `console.ai.assistant` | 助手 / Assistant | the agent-label fallback in `ChatPane` when no agent is found. `ChatPane` is shared with the Studio panel (`StudioAiCopilot`), so changing it would rename text there too (#34725's scope); unchanged |
| `console.ai.emptyDescription` | 可以直接提问，助手会结合… / Ask anything — the assistant has access… | generic empty state in the same shared `ChatPane`; same reason; unchanged |
| `console.ai.dock.open` | 打开助手 / Open assistant | read only by `ChatDockLauncher`, which no Console path mounts (only its own test renders it); unchanged |

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ChatDock.titleMatchesTopBar-34827.test.tsx` (its own file because the existing ChatDock harnesses mock `useObjectTranslation` with the inline defaults and cannot see a pack value). Real `AssistantTopBarButton`, `ChatDockPanel`, `ChatDockMobileSheet`, real `I18nProvider` and packs:
  - zh and en: the rail and the full window show the button's accessible name; **control**: the resize handle's name from the same pack (`调整对话宽度` / `Resize chat`), so a pack that never loaded is not read as a pass;
  - zh: the phone sheet heading;
  - every built-in pack: `console.ai.dock.title === topbar.aiAssistant`.
- Ablation (one-shot, not kept): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put zh-Hans `dock.title` back to `'助手'` (the mutated blob `77e56f98` equals the zh-Hans blob on `origin/main`), and the pin went red on the three zh cases with the en case green (`Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`); restore verified by blob hash against HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Verification

All readings below are on head `b34dabff8` (the branch with `origin/main` `fc5913e1` merged in), on a shared container.

<details><summary>Pin, package tests and type-check (through the shared verification lock)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/layout/`: `Test Files 243 passed (243)`, `Tests 2890 passed | 13 skipped (2903)`; the new pin is in that set.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts`: `Tests 152 passed (152)` (this file was red, 3 failures, before the `defaultValue` alignment).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exit 0.
- ESLint on the three changed test files and `en.ts`, from the ui root and from each package dir: exit 0, no output.
- The full app-shell suite is left to CI's `Test UI`: the diff changes one string literal in app-shell, and no app-shell test outside `layout/` reads that key.
</details>

<details><summary>Eager budget (merged tree)</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui/apps/console exec vite build`, then `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure` exit 0: `i18n-locale-en 60.4 KB / 60.5 KB ceiling (headroom 0.2 KB)`; the report gives the chunk as `gzipBytes: 61818` against the `62_000` ceiling, so 182 bytes are left. The ceiling is not touched.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 40 commands. 39 were re-run on `b34dabff8`, each `:: exit 0`. The 40th, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, was run on `6069d44b` (before the `defaultValue` fix): `Test Files 1 failed | 170 passed | 2 skipped (173)`, and the one failing file is the call-site-keys test, now green as shown above. `--ran` reconciliation: `40 derived, 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
Also run: `check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`, `check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` (`Every changed en value was followed by all 10 translation packs.`), `check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), each exit 0. `overlap-check`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` before the first content push and on the merge head `b34dabff8` (that run came right after its push, not before).
</details>
